citation: Fong SH, Kuenzi BM, Mattson NM, et al. A multilineage screen identifies actionable synthetic lethal interactions in human cancers. Nat Genet 57:154-164 (2025)
license: Springer Nature journal terms (supplementary information; not CC-licensed). Not open access in PMC (PMC12266356, isOpenAccess=N). Redistribute derived tables only.
label_rule: Evaluated rule (per line, authors' per-line cell-line-scores/cell-line-fdrs, NOT multi-lineage): positive = score <= -3 and FDR < 0.05; negative = |score| < 1 and FDR > 0.25; else null. Authors' score is z-standardised per line (sd 1) and their FDR is only weakly tied to |score| (FDR<0.05 occurs at |z|~0, and positive-score FDR<0.05 calls outnumber negative ones in 4/7 lines), so FDR alone is not a stringent call; the z<=-3 AND FDR<0.05 intersection is. SHIPPED: no line labelled (INCLUDED_LINES = ()); load() emits measurements with label null.

own_replication.method: Per-replicate additive GI re-scored from MOESM3 counts (replicates(), mode plasmid_last: LFC last timepoint vs plasmid, centred on control x control, f_g = median gene x AAVS, GI median over 9 guide pairs). Also guide-split pseudo-replicates (reps pooled; guide pairs split by parity of guide indices, 5 vs 4 guide pairs, singles split the same way). Split-rule AUROC both directions with 2% tail and z<=-3 positives. first_last and slope variants gave the same picture (all <0.66 except noted).
own_replication.summary: Fitness replicates (construct LFC r=0.32-0.76, single-gene r=0.48-0.91), but the interaction residual does not: bio-replicate GI Spearman 0.01-0.21; split-rule AUROCs 0.45-0.72, mostly 0.50-0.60; guide-split 0.39-0.68. Only A549 reaches >=0.65 in both directions, and only with z<=-3 on plasmid_last (0.70/0.67, 11/19 positives, bootstrap 95% CI [0.56,0.85]/[0.53,0.79]); it falls to 0.58/0.56 at the 2% tail, 0.62/0.57 (first_last), 0.66/0.62 (slope) and 0.53/0.58 (guide split) - not robust. CAL33 0.72 one direction only (0.59 other). Single-replicate AUROCs for the evaluated labels (0.72-0.89) are circular (labels come from pooled data including that replicate) and are not evidence.

A549_vs_shen2017_slkb.note: Shen 2017 (same lab, excluded from SLB labels itself). Too few Fong positives; Fong score does not recover Shen's hits.

authors_reference_SL_pairs_Table_S5.note: sign check: negative score = SL confirmed weakly (0.58-0.67)

cross_study.cross_line_within_fong_prior: hits in one line recovered by another line's score at AUROC 0.50-0.61 (prior check)

fitness_flag: Yes: DepMap -(f_a+f_b) predicts evaluated labels at 0.80 overall, 0.85-0.89 in CAL27/CAL33/MDA-MB-231.
verdict_reason: No cell line passes own replication robustly (bio-replicate and guide-split split-rule AUROCs mostly 0.45-0.60; the lone A549 pass at 0.70/0.67 is 11/19 positives and disappears under the 2% rule, other LFC definitions and guide splits). The only same-line cross-study overlap (A549 vs Shen 2017, 1,055 pairs) gives 0.44 for Shen's 29 hits and has 1 Fong positive. Evaluated labels are also largely predicted by single-gene fitness (0.80; >0.85 in 3 lines). Hit rate itself is plausible (0.04-0.35% per line). Keep scores/FDR as optional measurements with label null.
